speedup.end_time_s_source: run_inductive_benchmark bench schedule (.tran stop); not a measured trace endpoint
speedup.t_last_source: run_inductive_benchmark discards per-run time vectors; no measured trace endpoint is exposed, so t_last is N/A
speedup.completion_basis: count similarity is not required; lower counts are expected for faster models; aborted runs are rejected by positive iterations/points and no error. Both arms must also be full-schedule run_inductive_benchmark records: end_time_s equals the scheduled 20-pulse .tran stop and repeats == 3. The configured .tran stop is schedule metadata, not a measured trace endpoint.
